# JARVIS v2.0.8 Release Notes

### Highlights & New Features:
- **Advanced Trilingual Afreen**: Deep emotional companion upgrade with fluent conversational Hindi (Devanagari script), natural Hinglish (Roman script), and warm English.
- **High-Precision Scan AI**: Real-time object recognition, document reading, environment perception, and contextual multi-turn vision Q&A.
- **Universal Live Sports & Web Intelligence**: Real-time scores and statistics for up to 50 live matches across Cricket, Football, Badminton, and Tennis with bilingual team names and Hindi match support.
- **14-Language System Restored**: Permanent removal of auto-detect; full manual language selection restored across 14 languages (Hindi, Hinglish, English, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Bhojpuri, Punjabi, Odia, Urdu).
- **Seamless 4-Mode Personality Switching**: Smooth transition between JARVIS Pro, Afreen, Gemini, and Silent Soul with shared awareness and instant reconnect.
- **Smart Differential OTA Updates**: Chunked differential downloads with pause/resume support, SHA-256 verification, and robust fallback.
- **Developer Attribution Preserved**: Permanent "By SILENT SOUL" branding in navigation drawer header and footer.
